name: Axiomatic Set Mapping
description: Translates the scheduling problem into an abstract mathematical problem of finding subsets in a universe $U=\{1..T\}$. The sequential requirement becomes a supremum-infimum inequality between two sets, and the capacity requirements become pairwise disjointness constraints. This obscures the simple additive nature of the bottlenecks, forcing the model to logically deduce that disjoint subsets in a finite universe imply a total sum-of-sizes limit.
